contexts.text: After the separation of the body, human thought becomes more distinct and clear, and the ideas of thought become discrete, so as to serve for distinct forms of speech.
Colours there... are also presented discrete in other forms...
The words were not very discrete and separate from each other...
The ideas which were in the place of words, were discrete, but very little so.
They afterwards spoke with me by means of ideas still less discrete, so that hardly anything interstitial was perceived.
Truth is there presented as a discrete quantity; thus as much, or as minute, according to the quality of the truth.
(The musical instruments) which give a stridulous and discrete sound, signified spiritual Divine truths; but those which give a continuous sound, celestial Divine truths.
A roll seen, not continuous, but discrete. SE 3267.
Under Continue, see these references. DLW 185:end. DLW 219:2.
Under Atmosphere, see this reference.
These degrees are discrete, because they come forth distinctly.
Therefore the Angels dwell... more discretely and distinctly from each other than men.
The prayer... which is determined to a discrete Trinity, and not to a conjoined one...
As it were a discrete radiation...
So that I perceived... a continuous, but still generally discrete human...
With the Antediluvians this scandal was almost as it were continuous; but with their descendants after the Flood was made by the Lord as it were discrete. Explained.
(The gyres) were at last perceived as if they were continuous, while before they were most completely discrete.
Thus in a certain series, but discrete...
The speech of brutes is continuous; but that of Spirits is discrete... Therefore, with men, it is discrete and articulate.
Discrete sounds excite affections of truth... continuous ones, affections of good.
Successive order is not continuous, but discrete, to wit, the one from the other...
